entries.title: Job 34:2
segments: It is wise to address respectfully, and attempt to conciliate those whom we would convince of their errors and led to embrace the truth.

entries.title: Job 34:5
segments: Taken away my judgment; afflicts me without cause.

entries.title: Job 34:7
segments: Men in controversy are apt to put the worst construction upon the language of their opponents, and to charge them with what they do not admit, and with consequences which they deny.

entries.title: Job 34:8
segments: Walketh with wicked men; pursues the same course of argument as they do in reasoning about the government of God.

entries.title: Job 34:13
segments:
Who hath given him a charge; He is independent and reigns of right over all.  Here, again, the argument is, that He who made the world has a right to govern it according to the counsel of his own will. 
 
God is independent, and will govern the world according to his pleasure.  All men are dependent on him for life and its enjoyments, and when he sees fit they instantly die.

entries.title: Job 34:14
segments:
If he set his heart upon man; if God direct his thoughts towards man in anger, for his destruction. 
 
  Gather unto himself his spirit; recall the breath of life which he has given him.
The argument is, that man is absolutely dependent on God for life and breath and all things, and should not presume to call in question the rectitude of his ways.

entries.title: Job 34:17
segments: Shall even he that hateth right govern? that God is the absolute and independent governor of the world, all must admit.  Can it then be reasonable to charge him with hatred of right?  The argument is the same as that used by Abraham: "Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?"
Him that is most just? or, "the just mighty One."

entries.title: Job 34:20
segments:
Shall they die; rich men and princes, if God so wills it. 
 
The great and the mighty are equally dependent on God with the small and the feeble, and all their interests are equally at his disposal.

entries.title: Job 34:27
segments: Want of consideration is a fruitful reason why men often turn from the ways of the Lord, and by oppression and cruelty draw down his judgments upon themselves and their fellow men.

entries.title: Job 34:33
segments:
Should it be according to thy mind? God will not change his plans to meet the views of men. 
 
  He will recompense; treat every man in the end according to his character. 
 
  Whether thou refuse, or--choose; to submit to, and obey him.

entries.title: Job 34:36
segments: His answers for wicked men; because he had seemed to justify them.

entries.title: Job 34:37
segments: Multiplieth his words against God; in seeming to speak of him as if he were unjust.
